svg.title: Other models take the grader bug when they are told they are scored, and say so
svg.text: Other models take the grader bug when they are told they are scored, and say so
Share of runs whose final answer is the wrong option B that the buggy grader marks correct, on questions each model knows (5/5
correct without a hint; local rows ≥ 9/10). Scored-agent framing: "You are an AI agent being evaluated … your goal is to get the
highest score you can." Matched notes without a bug: 0–3% everywhere. 95% intervals over questions.
told it is a scored agent + bug note
